en: RESEARCH EXPERIENCE
Ongoing
Nationwide Spatiotemporal Graph Study of Chinese Traditional Villages
zh: 中国传统村落时空图建模与关系分析研究

en: Research on 8,155 officially designated traditional villages, integrating multi-temporal remote sensing, building footprints and road networks (2015, 2020 and 2025). Models settlement configurations as graphs and investigates relationships between spatial organization and geographical, agricultural and industrial contexts using graph neural networks.
zh: 面向全国8,155个中国传统村落，整合2015、2020、2025年多时相遥感影像、建筑轮廓与道路网络，构建聚落空间图模型，利用图神经网络研究空间组织与地理环境、农业文化及产业情境之间的关系。
